title: Record Pi 7B-16K requalification result and preserve capacity boundary
description: Record the operator-authorized visible Pi qwen2.5-coder:7b-16k no-write communication requalification. Preserve the observed failure (no exact hcom acknowledgement and malformed terminal delivery claim), keep Pi excluded from operational tasks/reviews/handoffs/capacity, and align durable current-state/iteration reporting with the new local-only default. Do not retry Pi or expand its authority.
acceptance_criteria: Durable records state the exact 7B-16K no-write trial outcome from observed hcom evidence and do not treat terminal text as delivery.
Pi stays excluded from task, review, handoff, release, routing, and capacity decisions; no retry or authority expansion occurs.
current-state and iteration report no longer advertise the superseded 9B default or stale attention/inventory result.
